evidence: Source inspection plus a tomllib parse of all six TOML files on the frozen bytes; no judge run was performed by this reviewer. (1) tests/scoring.toml:1-11 has all three tables: gates render=0.0, constraints=0.0; weights functional 0.6 + polish 0.2 + visual 0.2 = 1.0; floors functional=0.05; byte-identical to the frozen template. Each listed name has its directory in the right suite: tests/gates/{render,constraints}, tests/scored/{functional,polish,visual}; no extra tests/ entry and no reward.toml. score.py:10 resolves scoring.toml one level above tools/, and score.py, restart_mcp.py, test.sh, tests/Dockerfile are byte-identical to the template (diff). (2) All five judge.toml [judge] blocks carry judge="claude-code", mode="batched", isolated=false, prompt_template="prompt.md" and no model/reasoning_effort/temperature/weight key (e.g. gates/render/judge.toml:1-6). Each declares the playwright stdio MCP server with the template args (lines 8-12 in every file); playwright-mcp and /usr/local/bin/chromium are provided by tests/Dockerfile:19,38. (3) Only scored/functional/judge.toml:14-18 declares the second server name="verifier", command /usr/local/bin/python3, args ["/tests/tools/restart_mcp.py", "$APP_RESTART_HELPER"]; test.sh:127-193 generates the helper and exports APP_RESTART_HELPER before run_suite at test.sh:213/224; restart_mcp.py:9 reads it as argv[1]. Exactly one criterion calls the tool (cw_save_reload_restart, functional/judge.toml:339-344) and functional/prompt.md:31 restricts it to that criterion, matching the single-use marker at restart_mcp.py:29-32. (4) Criteria: gates/render 1 binary, gates/constraints 2 binary, both aggregation all_pass; functional 42 binary (weights 1.0 x15, 1.5 x21, 2.0 x6), polish 6 binary, visual 3 likert with points=5 and 0-5 anchors, all weighted_mean. All 54 ids are unique across files, id equals name, every weight is positive, every description is non-empty, and no criterion has an unexpected key. (5) Every prompt.md contains {app_context} and {criteria} and opens http://localhost:3000 (gates/*/prompt.md:1,3,7; functional/prompt.md:1,3,33; polish/prompt.md:1,3,22; visual/prompt.md:1,3,23); test.sh:195-201 substitutes {app_context} from tests/app_context.md, which exists with Application/Accounts/Key screens. (6) Budgets nest: gate judges 600+600 < 1500; scored judges 9000+900+900=10800 < 11100; 1500+11100=12600 < task.toml:27 verifier 13200. Runtime caveat (not a structural defect): raw-evidence-index.json records no configured judge run on these exact bytes; the hosted Oracle run that launched and graded all five dimensions was on an earlier candidate whose wiring files (test.sh, tools, scoring.toml, judge headers) are the same template-controlled files. Counterexample search: a judge.toml with a likert gate, a duplicated id, a missing {criteria}, a verifier server in a non-functional dimension, or an unexported helper variable would each break grading; none of these is present.
